# Abrade (FDN) -- Choose one --
#  * Abrade deals 3 damage to target creature.     (Turn to Slag's B5c-turn-to-slag atom, 3)
#  * Destroy target artifact.                       (compiled bullet, kept)
# Modal shape: M21 Destructive Tampering / M20 Reckless Air Strike's Choose(count 1).
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.INSTANT,
        effect=Choose(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            options=(
                A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
                    'amount': QConst(value=3),
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    ),
                }),
                compiled[0].effect,
            ),
        ),
    ),
]
